text: RETRACTION of my earlier closing note: FreeSurfer utils/mri.cpp MRIxfmCRS2XYZtkreg sets fixed tkregister axes (x_r=-1, z_a=1, y_s=-1) with only voxel sizes from the volume, so Torig does NOT share Norig's direction cosines. tkr->scanner = Norig*inv(Torig) is a pure c_ras translation only for LIA (conformed) volumes; for oblique/non-LIA volumes it also rotates. The review's point 3 was right. Fixed at f028c03f; nibabel's hard-coded LIA Torig is therefore FreeSurfer-correct in general.
